text: In response to a request from Council at its meeting on July 14, 2021, this report provides information and updates on a number of matters regarding the reconstruction of Lake Shore Boulevard East from the Don River to Carlaw Avenue, in accordance with the approved Environmental Assessment for the Port Lands Flood Protection project and the Council-adopted Gardiner Strategic Rehabilitation Plan. As authorized by City Council, Waterfront Toronto is undertaking the project, which includes the reconstruction of the existing Lake Shore Boulevard East Bridge over the Don River, as well as the provision of active transportation and public realm components outlined in the Gardiner East EA.
